Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private Deployment MAP: Aurora Systems — Connectivity & Secrets Ownership Kickoff

Hi Nora / Tim —

Thanks for agreeing to a MAP kickoff. We want to confirm roles, the evaluation plan and a realistic close window for Aurora's private/VPC deployment. Goal: complete evaluation and have an agreed SOW/hand-off by 2028-08-18 so your engineering and security teams can begin production planning.

Proposed Redwood leads (please confirm):
- Networking / VPN / Peering: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com)
- IAM / KMS / key policies: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com)
- Deployment topology & runtime config: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com)
- Program manager (MAP cadence & artifacts): Lauren Bishop (lauren.bishop@redwood.com)

Requested Aurora owners (please add or correct):
- Technical lead: (TBD)
- Networking contact: (TBD)
- Security / KMS contact: (TBD)

Attached: Aurora_MAP_Workbook_v1.xlsx (MAP tracker), aurora_network_topology_v1.png (reference diagram), sow-draft-Aurora-v0.3.pdf (draft SOW).

Immediate asks to keep to the timeline:
1) Confirm Aurora owners and point-of-contact emails.
2) Provide public IP ranges / expected throughput for VPN/peering.
3) Confirm whether Aurora needs BGP or static routes for peering.
4) Share preferred KMS workflow (customer-managed key vs Redwood-managed) and a contact for key policy review.

High-level MAP milestones (proposed):
- Week 1 (by 2028-08-01): infra provisioning (VPC, subnets, firewall rules) and key material exchange
- Week 2 (by 2028-08-07): baseline connectivity + smoke tests + basic integration tests
- Week 3 (by 2028-08-14): performance tuning, cost/latency evals, security review
- Target close (signoff): 2028-08-18

If this looks good I'll update the MAP workbook and spin up a shared tracker with weekly cadence (30m standup).

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

— Priyom
Priyom Das

Subject: Re: Private Deployment MAP: Aurora Systems — Connectivity & Secrets Ownership Kickoff

Appreciate the quick confirmation, Nora — welcome aboard Miguel and Priya. 

I'll lock in the Redwood assignments and update the MAP workbook (link below). A couple of clarifications and next steps from our side: 
- Kimberley will lead key policy review (customer-managed KMS if Aurora prefers) and coordinate a short design call with Priya.
- Vivek will own VPN/peering design + runbook; Marcus will own the topology diagram updates and runtime parameters we'll need during the eval.
- Lauren will send a recurring 30m MAP cadence invite (weekly) and maintain action item tracker.

Updated evaluation plan (concrete):
- Provisioning window: 7/29 — 8/1 (Redwood infra & Aurora VPC prep)
- Connectivity test window: 8/2 — 8/7 (VPN / peering + smoke tests)
- Functional perf window: 8/8 — 8/14 (load/latency data, model evals)
- Signoff and SOW finalization: target 8/18

Please share the following by Friday EOD:
- IP ranges / ASN (if BGP) / throughput profile
- KMS key contact and any required key policy templates
- Any compliance artifacts you want us to review during the security window (SOC attestation, third-party scans)

I'll attach the updated MAP workbook and a DocuSign link for the current SOW draft once procurement gives the go-ahead.

MAP workbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AuroraMAP
DocuSign (SOW draft): https://app.redwood.com/sow/RDW-3981/docusign

— Priyom

Subject: Re: Private Deployment MAP: Aurora Systems — Connectivity & Secrets Ownership Kickoff

Hi Miguel / team — quick note from the networking side. Two questions to determine peering approach: 
1) Do you prefer BGP-based dynamic peering or static routing? BGP gives us graceful failover and dynamic pathing, static is slightly simpler to validate quickly.
2) If BGP, please share the ASN and preferred BGP neighbors; if static, please provide the public IP ranges we should accept.

A couple more asks to size the tunnel: estimated sustained and burst throughput (Gbps) and whether you expect large NAT translations or a handful of fixed endpoints.

I can draft a short peering runbook once we have that info — happy to join a 30m call to walk through.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Timothy Reed <tim.reed@aurora-sys.com>

Subject: Re: Private Deployment MAP: Aurora Systems — Connectivity & Secrets Ownership Kickoff

Thanks all — apologies for the delay, team was pulled into a security sprint. Quick confirmations from Aurora: 
- Networking: we prefer BGP for the peering. ASN: 65050. Preferred neighbor IPs and full routing details Miguel will forward in a separate note (he's copied).
- Public IPs to allow to the tunnel: 198.51.100.0/24 (we will provide any additional ranges).
- Estimated throughput: sustained 250 Mbps, burst to 1 Gbps; NAT not expected to be heavy (few fixed endpoints).
- KMS / key contact: Priya Shah (priya.shah@aurora-sys.com) — she will send any key policy templates.

I've uploaded an edited MAP workbook with our notes to the shared drive: Aurora_MAP_Workbook_v1_AuroraNotes.xlsx

We can target the provisioning window you proposed; Miguel will be the primary for network tests. Procurement will review the SOW and return comments next week.

— Tim
